weapons.name: Flying Dragon
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3)
weapons.why: Fires a red crescent-shaped projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Influx Waver
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Saucer (Martian Madness)
weapons.why: Fires a teleporting blue sword projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Possessed Hatchet
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem
weapons.why: Homing hatchet dropped by Golem.

weapons.name: Golem Fist
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem (1/7)
weapons.why: Launched flail dropped by Golem that fires a high-velocity fist.

weapons.name: Starlight
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sword that streams rapid light slashes while held.

weapons.name: Sky Dragon’s Fury
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One’s Army
weapons.why: Nunchaku-style flail that spins and fires a homing burst.

weapons.name: Terra Blade
weapons.source: Crafted (True Excalibur + True Night's Edge + Broken Hero Swords)
weapons.why: Fires a fast green sword beam projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Seedler
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fires Seedler Nut projectiles that burst into thorn balls.

weapons.name: Christmas Tree Sword
weapons.source: Dropped by Everscream (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Fires ornament projectiles when swung.

weapons.name: North Pole
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon
weapons.why: Frost Moon spear that releases a homing snowflake and falling ice.

weapons.name: The Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.source: Dropped by Mothron during a Solar Eclipse (occurs post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera Solar Eclipse Mothron drop with infinite spin.

weapons.name: Flairon
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (1/6)
weapons.why: Hardmode flail from Duke Fishron, who requires no boss prerequisite to summon.

weapons.name: The Horseman's Blade
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Summons homing pumpkin projectiles when hitting enemies.

weapons.name: Vampire Knives
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Crimson Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of knives that heal the player on hit.

weapons.name: Keybrand
weapons.source: Dropped by Hardmode Dungeon armored bones
weapons.why: Deals bonus damage to enemies below half health.

weapons.name: Paladin's Hammer
weapons.source: Dropped by Paladins in the post-Plantera Dungeon
weapons.why: High-damage throwing hammer dropped by post-Plantera Dungeon Paladins.

weapons.name: Flower Pow
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Post-Plantera flail dropped by Plantera that releases petals.

armor.name: Beetle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Beetle Husks and Turtle Armor
armor.why: This is the clear pre-Cultist melee set because it finally turns the Golem farm into your best class armor.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: It continues to be the easiest best-in-slot melee accessory to justify all the way into the Lunar path.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.why: The damage and crit boost stacks perfectly with melee's now-mature weapon pool.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: The dodge and dash are both very relevant once event pressure and fast boss patterns dominate the phase.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: A broad stat bump remains strong once your class-specific melee slots are already established.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.source: Crafted from Band of Regeneration and Philosopher's Stone.
accessories.why: Steady life regen and a shorter healing-potion cooldown keep you topped up.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense reduction remains the strongest and most practical melee imbue in this phase.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Even at this gear level, the baseline defense increase is still always worth taking.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: Extra health gives you more room to survive event chaos and late-phase boss patterns.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase helps shorten the demanding optional farms that dominate this phase.

weapons.name: Aerial Bane
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Tier 3 Old One's Army, post-Golem)
weapons.why: Fires arrows that split into extra arrows when aimed upward.

weapons.name: Xenopopper
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer (Martian Madness)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of bullets and drops from the Martian Saucer during post-Golem Martian Madness.

weapons.name: Celebration
weapons.source: Purchased from the Party Girl after Golem is defeated
weapons.why: Fires a spread of firework rockets using rocket ammo.

weapons.name: Electrosphere Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness (post-Golem)
weapons.why: Fires rockets that leave a lingering electrified damage field.

weapons.name: Stynger
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem
weapons.why: Fires Stynger Bolts that burst into shrapnel on impact.

weapons.name: Elf Melter
weapons.source: Dropped by Santa-NK1 during the Frost Moon
weapons.why: Frost Moon flamethrower with strong sustained damage.

weapons.name: Eventide
weapons.source: Dropped by Empress of Light (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing star arrows, converting wooden arrows for free.

weapons.name: Snowman Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing rockets that track the nearest enemy.

weapons.name: Chain Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Santa-NK1 (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Rapid-fire gun dropped by Santa-NK1 during the post-Plantera Frost Moon.

weapons.name: Stake Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: A repeater that fires high-damage Stakes as its ammunition.

weapons.name: Piranha Gun
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Jungle Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Latches a piranha onto an enemy that chews continuously.

weapons.name: Sniper Rifle
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeleton Snipers in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: High single-shot damage gun dropped by Skeleton Snipers after Plantera.

weapons.name: Tsunami
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: Fires five arrows in a spread from a single arrow.

weapons.name: Pulse Bow
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant after defeating all three mechanical bosses
weapons.why: Fires a piercing pulse arrow that bounces off blocks.

weapons.name: Nail Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Nailheads during a Solar Eclipse (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires Nails that stick into surfaces and enemies.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: This is still the ranger armor to beat because nothing else in the phase offers a better full package.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: It stays the top ranger accessory thanks to its crit and aim support on already strong weapons.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: A direct ranged-damage boost still fits cleanly into nearly every serious setup.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The broad stat boost remains useful once your core ranger pieces are already locked in.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity keeps its value in the event-heavy and Dungeon-adjacent parts of the phase.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.source: Crafted from Avenger Emblem and Eye of the Golem.
accessories.why: +10% damage and +8% crit, stacking with your class emblem.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: It remains the best simple ranger buff, especially because several top-tier options still lean on bows.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo efficiency gets even more valuable once your weapons start firing at endgame-like rates.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: It is still free ranged value before every major encounter.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.

weapons.name: Charged Blaster Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Madness enemies (post-Golem)
weapons.why: Charges up to fire a large piercing laser beam.

weapons.name: Laser Machinegun
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness (post-Golem)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires lasers in a cone, increasing fire rate when used continuously.

weapons.name: Heat Ray
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem
weapons.why: Fires a beam that hits instantaneously.

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.why: Fires a projectile that reduces enemy defense and creates homing shards.

weapons.name: Staff of Earth
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem
weapons.why: Throws large bouncing boulders that explode on impact.

weapons.name: Blizzard Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Ice Queen (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Calls down a barrage of ice shards from the sky over an area.

weapons.name: Razorpine
weapons.source: Dropped by Everscream (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires piercing pine-needle projectiles.

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.

weapons.name: Razorblade Typhoon
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: Fires high-velocity homing typhoons that pierce enemies and bounce off blocks.

weapons.name: Magnet Sphere
weapons.source: Dropped by armored bones and Diabolists in the post-Plantera Dungeon
weapons.why: Launches a slow sphere that fires lightning bolts at nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Clinger Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics (1/5) in the Hardmode Underground Corruption
weapons.why: Generates a lasting wall of Cursed Flame that damages and inflicts Cursed Inferno on enemies passing through.

weapons.name: Nightglow
weapons.source: Dropped by Empress of Light (summoned post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires a homing prismatic bolt that rains down piercing feathers.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus (1/15) during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.

weapons.name: Stellar Tune
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles that pass through blocks and explode on impact.

weapons.name: Bubble Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable in early Hardmode, no boss prerequisite)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires a short-range spread of bubbles.

weapons.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
weapons.source: Dropped by Ogres during Tier 2 Old One's Army (requires one mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Fires bursts of pages, or with right-click a large piercing tornado.

weapons.name: Shadowbeam Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Necromancers (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a fast beam that ricochets off walls and pierces enemies.

weapons.name: Wasp Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fires several homing wasp projectiles per shot.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: The damage-focused Spectre setup stays the best default mage armor right up until Lunar gear exists.

armor.name: Spectre Hood Loadout
armor.why: You still want access to the lifesteal variant when survivability matters more than peak DPS.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: This remains the cleanest premium mage accessory because it combines damage and mana utility without any downside.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The all-around stat lift is still useful once the core mage resource slots are already solved.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-potion support stays valuable because the strongest mage weapons still chew through mana rapidly.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is a meaningful comfort boost during the phase's event-heavy grind.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Crafted from Magic Cuffs and Celestial Magnet.
accessories.why: Turns damage taken into mana and pulls in nearby mana stars.

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.source: Crafted from Band of Regeneration and Philosopher's Stone.
accessories.why: Steady life regen and a shorter healing-potion cooldown keep you topped up.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: It stays the best direct damage buff for mage and never really falls out of favor.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Mana sustain continues to matter because the late mage tools get expensive very quickly.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: It is still free power before every major attempt, so it remains part of the baseline setup.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.

weapons.name: Xeno Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness
weapons.why: Summons UFO minions with instantaneous non-missing attacks; event is post-Golem.

weapons.name: Ballista Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the ballista bolt sentry.

weapons.name: Explosive Trap Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the explosive trap sentry.

weapons.name: Flameburst Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the flameburst fireball sentry.

weapons.name: Lightning Aura Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the lightning aura sentry.

weapons.name: Tempest Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable any time in Hardmode)
weapons.why: Summons Sharknado minions; Duke Fishron requires only Hardmode, no mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Raven Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Summons Raven minions; obtained from the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon event.

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Dropped by Armored Bones enemies in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: Dropped by Hardmode Dungeon Armored Bones and gains crit chance with combos.

weapons.name: Electric Eel
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable in Hardmode, no boss prerequisite)
weapons.why: Duke Fishron drop with long range that chains lightning between enemies.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.

weapons.name: Terraprisma
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light if all damage is dealt during the day
weapons.why: Summons homing sword minions; Empress is fought via a post-Plantera Prismatic Lacewing.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Pumpking drop whose swings can hit multiple times with a strong summon tag.

weapons.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Deadly Spheres during a post-Plantera Solar Eclipse
weapons.why: Summons orbiting Deadly Sphere minions that dash at enemies.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.why: It remains the standard pre-Cultist summoner armor because the minion capacity is still the most practical upgrade.

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.why: It stays the best summoner accessory because it improves both minion count and direct summon scaling.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: An extra minion remains simple, obvious value this late into the game.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The broad stat bonus supports both your summon output and your ability to stay in control of the fight.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is still a big quality-of-life and survivability gain for the class.

accessories.name: Necromantic Scroll
accessories.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon.
accessories.why: +1 minion and +10% minion damage, a core summoner slot.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: It remains the best summoner buff because another minion is always worth the slot.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It stacks perfectly with your potion setup and should always be active for real attempts.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner still wants every baseline survivability layer it can reasonably get.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense reduction is too strong to ignore, which makes this the best melee weapon imbue for the phase.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with Acid Venom.

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
